rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase (3/1/26-2/28/27)
rules.requirement: For units subject to San Francisco rent control, landlords may raise a tenant's base rent by at most 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. The increase is calculated by multiplying the tenant's base rent by .016.

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies only to rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance; no building age, unit-count, or ownership details given in this document.

rules.interaction: This is the annually-recalculated allowable increase percentage under the Rent Ordinance's CPI-based formula; the prior period (March 1, 2025 - February 28, 2026) allowable increase was 1.4%.
rules.quoted_span: the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%
rules.conflict_note: Document is a Rent Board news announcement stating the figure produced by the ordinance's existing formula rather than quoting the ordinance's text directly; citation to S.F. Admin. Code ch. 37 is inferred as the underlying authorizing law.
